itens.trecho: "Mobland" is a larger than life but nonetheless watchable, Brit crime drama. This series feels somewhat like a satire, of your British organised crime, figures.Its loud tones, predictable stereotypes and at times implausible plot twists, do tend to rob it, of certain, credibility.

Mobland is an entertaining gangster story. That's it. Nothing spectacular and nothing mediocre. With Guy Ritchie involved in the series there is indeed that classic many plots intermingling in the overall story treatment. One thing that stands out in this series is Pierce Brosnan's performance. Definitely not Tom Hardy's.
